title: "PeMS Data Quality"
subtitle: "September–October 2025"
jupyter: python3
---

```{python}
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd

summary = pd.read_csv("data/qc_summary.csv")
period_failures = pd.read_csv("data/qc_period_failures.csv")

# Normalize qc_pass in case CSV reads it as string
summary["qc_pass"] = (
    summary["qc_pass"]
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
)

total = summary["station_days"].sum()

passed = summary.loc[
    summary["qc_pass"] == "true",
    "station_days",
].sum()

failed = total - passed

pass_rate = 100 * passed / total if total else 0
```

## Overview

This report summarizes completeness and quality checks applied to PeMS
station-day observations used to develop weekday traffic counts.

| Measure | Value |
|---|---:|
| Station-days evaluated | `{python} f"{total:,.0f}"` |
| Station-days passing QC | `{python} f"{passed:,.0f}"` |
| Station-days failing QC | `{python} f"{failed:,.0f}"` |
| QC pass rate | `{python} f"{pass_rate:.1f}%"` |

## Completeness by Time Period

The table below shows the number of station-days that do not contain the
expected number of five-minute observations in each model time period.

```{python}
#| echo: false

periods = (
    period_failures
    .rename(
        columns={
            "ea_failures": "EA",
            "am_failures": "AM",
            "md_failures": "MD",
            "pm_failures": "PM",
            "ev_failures": "EV",
        }
    )
    .T
    .reset_index()
)

periods.columns = [
    "Time period",
    "Incomplete station-days",
]

periods["Incomplete station-days"] = (
    periods["Incomplete station-days"]
    .astype(int)
)

periods
```

## Quality Criteria

A station-day currently passes QA/QC when all expected five-minute
observations are present.

| Time period | Expected observations |
|---|---:|
| EA | 36 |
| AM | 36 |
| MD | 78 |
| PM | 42 |
| EV | 96 |
| Full service day | 288 |

The service day is defined from **3:00 AM to 3:00 AM** the following day.

At this stage, the QA/QC criteria focus on data completeness. Additional
checks, such as percent observed, detector reliability, and traffic-count
reasonableness, can be incorporated as the quality framework is expanded.
